title: hotspots block props
description: An interactive picture (« Image interactive »; Rise's labeled graphic): markers on one picture, each opening a short text about the part it points at. Presentations: popover (the text floats by its marker), side (the text beside the picture), below (the text under the picture) and tour (the markers in order, one text at a time with Previous and Next). Markers are 44 px at least, numbered by default, and never pulse. In places narrower than 560 px (a phone, a column) the texts become a numbered list under the picture, the markers numbered on it; a tour stays a tour.
x-ai-instructions: Use it when the learner must find parts on one picture (a machine, a screen, a document, a map): three to six markers (W_ITEMS_MANY over eight), each a title of a few words (about 15 characters) and one or two sentences (120 to 270 characters). x and y place each marker from 0 to 1 of the whole picture (0, 0 its top left), whatever crops it later: point at the part itself. Markers closer than 44 px on a phone overlap (W_HOTSPOTS_CLOSE): move them apart or split the picture. tour when the parts have an order (a path, a procedure); otherwise popover. Give the picture its alt (what it shows as a whole); the markers carry the details.

presentation.description: popover: the text floats by its marker, over the picture; side: beside the picture; below: under it; tour: the markers in order, one text at a time under the picture with Previous and Next.

image.description: The picture the markers sit on.

alt.description: What the picture shows as a whole. Required unless decorative is true.

decorative.description: True only when the markers' texts say everything the picture shows.

focus.description: Where the subject is. In places narrower than 560 px the picture is then shown half as large again, cropped at its sides around this point, so that its markers have room; a marker the crop leaves out stays at the picture's edge. Without focus the picture is never cropped.

items.description: The markers, in reading order (their numbers, and a tour's order).

id.description: Stable id of the marker: its visited mark and its translations name it.

x.description: Where the marker points, across the whole picture before any crop: 0 its left edge, 1 its right edge. The editor and the player read it the same way.

y.description: Where the marker points, down the whole picture before any crop: 0 its top edge, 1 its bottom edge.

title.description: The part in a few words; the marker is named « 2. title ».

markdown.description: What to know about it: one or two sentences.

image.description: A detail shown with the text (a close-up).

alt.description: What the detail shows; empty: decorative.

markerStyle.description: number: each marker shows its number; icon: each shows the icon (the list on narrow places keeps the numbers).

icon.description: markerStyle icon: the icon of every marker.

prompt.description: What to do or look for, shown above the picture (« Sélectionnez chaque repère… »).

generated.description: True if the picture was produced by an AI model; the player shows a mark and the build report lists it.
